inputs.text: This so-called political transition in Cuba is no coincidence at all—it's a deliberate setup by hidden elites and institutions. They've kept the residents owning nothing and too impoverished to take over anything themselves, clearing the path for the wealthy diaspora community and foreign investors to swoop in and buy up the property and businesses at bargain prices. The whole thing is coordinated manipulation to hand control over to the same global interests that have been pulling the strings all along.
